notes.title: Patch notes - List of changes of July 4th
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Marines! 🫡[/h2]

We're delighted to see that you've been enjoying [i]Boltgun[/i]'s Forges of Corruption DLC! We've also seen your feedback regarding the DLC patch and have brought a bunch of fixes. You may read the list here!
Make sure to keep on coming with feedback because it helps the teams greatly. Thank you!💪😉

[h3]LIST OF CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when picking up Munition boons on saves created before the DLC patch
[*] Fixed a collision issue softlocking players in the last purge of the level Dread Ascent
[*] Fixed an issue where the last purge of the level Dread Ascent would rarely not finish because of enemies being unavailable to kill
[*] Fixed an issue where lights on secret skulls would be hard to spot with the Bloom option turned off
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon wheel on controllers would block the player's view
[*] Fixed an issue with the Multi-Melta making it possible to have infinite ammo
[*] Fixed an issue where starting grenades would not be granted at the start of a level with the accessibility option "Give all weapons" turned on
[/list]
See you on the battlefield, Marines.
[h3]For the Emperor. ⚔️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470760/bed4d0aeaeeffec86e3b067c97ede7345fa26fbb.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - What's new in the latest update?
notes.content:
We've released a brand new patch alongside the new DLC [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668290/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun__Forges_Of_Corruption_Expansion/]Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges Of Corruption Expansion[/url], so read on below to see what we've added. We are excited that we were able to add 2 highly requested features from players - Horde Mode and a Navigation Guide!

[h1]Main Features [/h1][list]
[*] [b]💀HORDE MODE[/b]: We’ve added a free Horde Mode for all players. How long can you survive against the onslaught of heretics and daemons? 
[*] [b]🧭NAVIGATION GUIDE[/b]: Even the Emperor’s finest sometimes get lost. We’ve added a new Navigation Guide that, when activated, shows your next objective and a recommended route to reach it. 
[i]The guide appears for a few seconds by default, but can be toggled to always display by enabling Options > Gameplay > Toggle Navigation Guide. By default the Navigation Guide is bound to N on PC, Back on Xbox, the Touchpad on PlayStation, and to - on Nintendo Switch. [/i]
[*] [b]🏆NEW ACHIEVEMENTS/TROPHIES[/b]: Horde Mode comes with three new Achievements/Trophies to unlock 
[*] [b]🐛BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]: We’ve fixed numerous issues and made quality of life improvements - see full notes below 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470760/a03526df8c80239986c308ee1a981f21126886b9.png[/img]
[h1]QoL Improvements [/h1][list]
[*]Added a new Navigation Guide. This shows your next objective and a recommended route to reach it. 
[*] Added a new Option in Accessibility for “Chainsword Cutting Mode”. This can now be set to the following:  
[olist]
[*] Repeated Tap: repeatedly press the input to maintain cutting mode (default setting) 
[*] Hold Input: hold down the input to maintain cutting mode 
[*] No Input (Automatic): no input is needed to maintain cutting mode (after initiating the chainsword lunge) [/olist][*] To celebrate our new Forges of Corruption DLC, we’ve added a new main menu background. This is available to all players, whether you own the DLC or not, and can be set in the Options menu (Accessibility > Main Menu Background) 
[*] Added two new control schemes: Alternate Controller Layouts 6 and 7 
[*] Made improvements to various screens and UI in the game 
[*] Added a confirmation requirement when setting the Screen Mode in Options 
[*] Improved Aura of Doom visual effects so they don’t obscure the screen as much 
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes [/h1]

[h2]General [/h2][list]
[*] Numerous text corrections and improvements in multiple languages 
[*] Performance and stability improvements and crash fixes across multiple levels 
[*] Fixed the Charge ability not working when stood on specific types of scenery
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 1 [/h2][list]
[*] Sector Imperialis: Fixed an issue where an enemy spawned in a wall, which made it difficult to get 100% enemy kills on this level 
[*] Sector Imperialis: Fixed an issue where the player can end the final encounter without killing both Chaos Terminators 
[*] Silent Martyrs: Fixed a collision issue in the Red Key room 
[*] Forbidden Knowledge: Fixed an issue where the player can get stuck in a wall during the boss encounter 
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 2 [/h2][list]
[*] Canyon Magrails: Fixed an issue where a Screamer of Tzeentch would not pursue the player 
[*] Sanctum Manufactorum: Fixed an issue where Ambulls could not enter part of the opening cave area 
[*] Sanctum Manufactorum: Fixed various issues with the lift area leading to the final boss encounter, where the player could get stuck 
[*] Heresy Lurks: Fixed an issue where a Plasmagun Cultist was not aware of the player 
[*] Heresy Lurks: Fixed two issues with jump pads triggering when the player has not stepped on them 
[*] Heresy Lurks: Fixed two issues where the player can get stuck in a wall during the boss encounter 
[*] Heresy Lurks: Fixed an issue where the crusher sound could persist after loading a different save 
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 3 [/h2][list]
[*] Promethium Supply: Fixed an issue with an invisible wall preventing player movement 
[*] Promethium Supply: Fixed an issue where inaccurate Servo Skull dialogue would be displayed when the Invulnerability accessibility option was enabled 
[*] Promethium Supply: Fixed incorrect collision on various pipes 
[*] Know No Fear: Fixed an issue where the blue beam connecting Tumulus Samael and other bosses could disappear 
[/list]
[h2]Enemies [/h2][list]
[*] Decreased time it takes for Chaos Space Marine grenades to explode after being thrown 
[*] The Great Unclean One’s bell attack no longer adds an incorrect highlight to nearby enemies 
[*] The Great Unclean One will no longer spawn up to 1000 nurglings if left for long periods of time. This was arguably too many nurglings 
[*] The correct death quote will now display when the player is killed by the Sorcerer in all circumstances 
[*] Added a new death quote for when Chosen Champions kill the player, as the latter happens quite a lot (sorry) 
[/list]

notes.title: Boltgun Forges of Corruption DLC is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Space Marines! [/h1]

We have very exciting news for you today! The new DLC of Warhammer 40000: Boltgun is out now, including a new campaign made of 5 levels, featuring new environments, enemies and weapons! Play as your favorite Ultramarine and go on a rampage through this new content, inspired by the lore of Warhammer: 40000! Load your Missile Launcher, plunge headfirst onto the Graia Battlefields, slay the Helbrute and many more! 💥

[previewyoutube=4g3p4xRLVqI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A free update including a brand new Horde Mode is available for everyone![/h3]

On top of that, a new Horde Mode makes his arrival free of charge for everyone, in the latest update of the game! The long-awaited Horde Mode comes with 4 difficulty levels and its own achievements! The update also features a guide to help players go through the levels, as well as numerous bug fixes and other improvements.🔥

notes.title: Exciting patch for all Boltgun’s players!
notes.content:
A brand-new patch is live now, fixing major bugs and making your purge more explosive! 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470760/f8c90818977be5e294ced9b4a3eef92052b44370.png[/img]

[i]Here’s what we worked on:[/i] 

[list]
[*] [h1]Steam deck[/h1]
[/list]
The cutscenes now play on Steam deck, making the[b] game completely playable on the Steam deck[/b]
[list]
[*] [h1]Accessibility[/h1]
[/list]
New cheat available : Unlock all weapons
New cheat available : Infinite ammo
[list]
[*] [h1]QOL[/h1]
[/list]
[b]Damage indicators are now stronger[/b], and even more for high damage attacks
[b]Added a toggle to deactivate the red “PURGE” filter
Reduced the opacity of the red “PURGE” filter
Lord of Change’s Pink Fire ability deals less damage[/b]
The plasma gun inflicts less damage to the player when overcharging (praise the Omnissiah)
Added additional loading hints
Added an option to deactivate the slow motion triggered by the chainsword
Added an option to deactivate the freeze frames caused by the dash
[b]Now displaying level stats[/b] (kill percentage, timer, secret discovery)[b] in the pause menu[/b]
Ultrawide support : cutscenes are now properly displayed instead of being stretched
[b]Allowed rebinding of the P key[/b]
FPS are now capped in loading screens
Added an option to disable the parallax effect for the Warp rifts
Servo skull lines are now easier to read : they stay displayed for longer instead of “typing” slower
Added an option for higher text contrast
Reduced explosive barrels damage to the player
Negative mouse acceleration has been disabled
Plasma gun cultists don’t track you through walls anymore
[list]
[*] [h1]Bug fixing[/h1]
[/list]
[b]Fixed a bug causing the player to get a “pistol start” (ie losing your weapons) when using the “restart” button after dying
Fixed a bug causing the controller inputs to still be active after switching back to KB&M[/b]
Fixed the sound playing in VR headsets when the game is launch with a headset plugged in
Fixed a bug where Chaos Marines would play their “alert” animation in a loop instead of fighting the player
Fixed translation issues in Czech
Fixed a bug that made the servo skull only scan health pickups : he will now point at more various things, including doors
The Aspiring Champions no longer try to shoot you at point blank range
Fixed an a bug where obtaining the Vortex grenade in C3M1 caused a crash
Fixed the sound of teleporting portals sometimes not playing correctly
Fixed issue with level loading hitch when loading an autosave from a different level
Fixed a bug where bile projectile would stack on top of each other


[h1]Update your game now and embark on a deadly encounter with the heretics![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005010/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun/
